hero.title: Why Choose Invisalign®
hero.p1: A confident smile should feel natural — not forced, not hidden, and not uncomfortable. At Dallas Smiles Dental & Orthodontics, we offer Invisalign® as a modern orthodontic solution designed for people who want straighter teeth without disrupting their lifestyle.
hero.p2: Unlike traditional braces, Invisalign uses a series of custom-made, clear aligners that gradually guide your teeth into their ideal position. These aligners are virtually invisible, comfortable to wear, and removable — giving you the flexibility that metal braces simply cannot offer.

doctor.title: Personalized Invisalign Treatment
doctor.p1: Dr. Sandeep Bariki carefully evaluates each patient’s bite, alignment, and facial harmony to create a personalized digital treatment plan.
doctor.p2: Using advanced 3D imaging technology, you can even preview how your smile is expected to look before treatment begins.

conditions.title: Invisalign Can Treat
conditions.subtitle: Invisalign aligners are designed to treat many common orthodontic problems comfortably and discreetly.
conditions.bottom: Whether you're a busy professional, a teen involved in activities, or an adult who never had braces growing up, Invisalign allows you to improve your smile discreetly and comfortably.

c1.title: Crowded Teeth
c1.desc: Teeth overlap because there isn't enough room in the jaw.

c2.title: Spacing Issues
c2.desc: Gaps between teeth caused by missing teeth or jaw size.

c3.title: Overbite
c3.desc: Upper teeth overlap too much over the lower teeth.

c4.title: Underbite
c4.desc: Lower teeth extend past the upper teeth when biting.

c5.title: Crossbite
c5.desc: Some upper teeth sit inside the lower teeth instead of outside.

c6.title: Alignment Concerns
c6.desc: Invisalign can treat mild to moderate alignment issues.

kids.title: Invisalign for Kids & Teenagers
kids.p1: Invisalign is a great orthodontic option for kids and teenagers who want a comfortable and nearly invisible way to straighten their teeth. Unlike traditional braces, Invisalign aligners are made from clear, smooth plastic that fits comfortably over the teeth and gradually moves them into proper alignment.
kids.p2: Because the aligners are removable, kids and teens can easily take them out while eating, brushing, and flossing. This helps maintain better oral hygiene and allows them to continue enjoying their favorite foods without restrictions.
kids.p3: Invisalign is especially popular among teenagers because it allows them to straighten their teeth discreetly while staying confident in school, sports, and social activities.

braces.title: Advanced Dental Braces for a Perfect Smile
braces.p1: Dental braces are a highly effective solution for correcting misaligned teeth, bite issues, and overcrowding. Our customized orthodontic treatments are designed to gradually move your teeth into the ideal position for a healthier and more confident smile.
braces.p2: We offer modern braces options that are comfortable, efficient, and suitable for both teens and adults. Our expert team ensures precise adjustments and continuous monitoring throughout your treatment journey.

b1.desc: Clear aligners blend naturally with your teeth so most people won’t notice treatment.

hero.desc: Deep teeth cleaning, also called scaling and root planing, removes harmful bacteria, plaque, and tartar from beneath the gumline so your gums can heal and your smile can stay healthy.
hero.badgeText: A healthier foundation for your smile

intro.title: Treat the cause, not just the symptoms
intro.desc: When plaque hardens into tartar and spreads below the gums, it can cause inflammation, bleeding, gum recession, and even bone loss. Scaling and root planing removes these deposits and gives your gums the clean surface they need to heal and reattach to your teeth.
intro.note: Unlike a routine cleaning, this treatment reaches below the gumline and is designed for patients with signs of gum disease.

steps.title: Two careful steps

scaling.title: Scaling
scaling.desc: We carefully remove plaque and tartar from above and below the gumline, including deep pockets around the teeth.

planing.title: Root planing
planing.desc: We smooth the root surfaces to help prevent bacteria from reattaching and support healthy gum healing.

signs.title: When might you need a deep cleaning?

hero.desc: Missing teeth can affect more than just your smile—they can impact your ability to chew, speak, and feel confident in everyday life. At Dallas Smiles Dental & Orthodontics, we offer advanced dental implant solutions designed to replace missing teeth with natural-looking, long-lasting results. Whether you're replacing a single tooth or restoring your entire smile, our team is committed to providing personalized care using proven techniques and premium implant systems.

what.title: What Are Dental Implants?
what.desc: Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. They consist of a small titanium implant that is placed into the jawbone, where it functions as an artificial tooth root. Once the implant has integrated with the bone, a custom-made crown, bridge, or denture is securely attached, creating a restoration that looks, feels, and functions like a natural tooth. Unlike removable dentures, dental implants are fixed in place, providing exceptional stability and helping preserve the health of your jawbone.

benefits.title: Benefits of Dental Implants
benefits.desc: Dental implants offer numerous advantages over traditional tooth replacement options:
benefits.l2: Restore normal chewing and speaking ability
benefits.l3: Prevent jawbone loss after tooth extraction
benefits.l6: Stable and secure—no slipping or movement
benefits.l8: Easy to maintain like natural teeth

single.title: Single Tooth Implants
single.desc: Replace one missing tooth with a custom implant and crown without affecting neighboring teeth.

bridge.title: Implant Bridges
bridge.desc: Replace several missing teeth using strategically placed implants instead of relying on natural teeth for support.

denture.title: Implant-Supported Dentures
denture.desc: Enjoy a more stable, comfortable alternative to traditional dentures. Implant-supported dentures reduce movement while improving chewing efficiency and confidence.

fullArch.title: Full-Arch Implant Restorations
fullArch.desc: For patients missing most or all of their teeth, full-arch implant solutions can restore an entire smile using a limited number of strategically placed implants.

step1.title: Comprehensive Consultation
step1.desc: We begin with a thorough examination, digital X-rays, and a CBCT 3D scan to evaluate your bone structure and determine whether implants are the right solution for you.

step2.title: Personalized Treatment Planning
step2.desc: Every smile is unique. We create a customized treatment plan based on your oral health, goals, and budget.

step3.title: Implant Placement
step3.desc: The titanium implant is carefully placed into the jawbone using precise surgical techniques for optimal positioning and long-term stability.

step4.title: Healing & Integration
step4.desc: Over the next few months, the implant naturally fuses with the jawbone through a process called osseointegration.

step5.title: Final Restoration
step5.desc: Once healing is complete, we place your custom-designed crown, bridge, or denture, restoring your smile with beautiful, functional results.

Our commitment to continuing education and modern techniques helps ensure every implant procedure is performed with accuracy, efficiency, and patient comfort in mind.

affordability.title: Affordable Dental Implants with Flexible Financing
affordability.desc: At Dallas Smiles Dental & Orthodontics, we believe everyone deserves access to high-quality tooth replacement. We strive to make dental implants as affordable and accessible as possible.
affordability.insuranceDesc: Our knowledgeable team works with most major dental insurance plans and will help determine whether your plan includes implant benefits. For patients who qualify for coverage, we'll maximize your insurance benefits and explain your estimated out-of-pocket costs before treatment begins—so there are no surprises.
affordability.financingDesc: For patients without insurance or those seeking additional payment flexibility, we offer affordable pricing along with convenient financing options through our trusted financial partners. Qualified patients may be eligible for 0% APR financing (subject to approval and the financing partner's terms and conditions), allowing you to spread the cost of treatment into manageable monthly payments. Our goal is to help you receive the care you need without unnecessary financial stress.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long do dental implants last?
faq.a1: With proper home care and regular dental visits, dental implants can last for decades and often a lifetime.
faq.a2: Most patients report minimal discomfort. Local anesthesia is used during the procedure, and many patients return to normal activities within a day or two.
faq.q3: How long does the entire process take?
faq.a3: Treatment time varies depending on healing and individual needs, but most implant cases are completed over several months.
faq.q4: Can implants replace multiple missing teeth?
faq.a4: Yes. Implants can support individual crowns, bridges, or full-arch restorations depending on your needs.
faq.a5: Absolutely. Your restoration is custom-made to match the color, shape, and size of your surrounding teeth for a seamless appearance.
